subject: CAIQ control synthesis & evidence handback — EdgeScale pilot choreography
messages:
From: Claire Donovan <claire@edgescale.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@edgescale.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: EdgeScale CAIQ intake — pilot scope and evidence tieout

Hi Irene / Marissa,

Thanks for agreeing to run a compact CAIQ intake for our EdgeScale pilot. Attached is our filled questionnaire (EdgeScale_CAIQ_Questions_v1.xlsx) — we've highlighted ~38 controls we expect to validate during the pilot window. The ask from compliance is pretty targeted: confirm mapping to Redwood controls, provide evidence stubs (logs/config screenshots/stated policies), and indicate any controls requiring longer-term sampling.

What we need from Redwood this week:
- A mapping file that links each highlighted CAIQ question to your control ID and an evidence owner.
- A short plan (2–3 bullets) for how you will deliver runtime/log samples for two controls we flagged (network boundary enforcement and key rotation audit).
- A single point of contact for evidence transfer and any Portal/Drive links we should use.

Can you confirm the above and provide a tentative timeline for delivering the mapping and first evidence batch? Our pilot kickoff is next Monday and procurement will need a deliverable for their file.

Attachments: EdgeScale_CAIQ_Questions_v1.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Donovan
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
EdgeScale
procurement@edgescale.com

---
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Claire Donovan <claire@edgescale.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EdgeScale CAIQ intake — pilot scope and evidence tieout

Claire — thanks for the questionnaire and the highlighted scope. Quick read-through attached (redwood-caiq-mapping-template.csv) with the mapping columns we'll populate: CAIQ_ID, Redwood_Control_ID, Evidence_Type, Owner, Delivery_Method, Expected_Delivery.

High level approach:
1) Triage: Marissa and I will split the 38 highlighted items — Marissa will own infra/runtime controls; I'll own identity/configure/ops controls. Rishi will field anything that needs engineering-level logs.
2) Evidence format: we will return a CSV mapping + a zipped evidence bundle for the first 15 controls (config screenshots, short log excerpts, PDF attestations where appropriate). For controls requiring continuous sampling (e.g., KV cache rotation telemetry), we will provide a sampling plan and one-week sample run.
3) Timeline: mapping CSV + evidence owner roster by EOD Friday (2026-05-22 17:00 PT). First evidence bundle (15 controls) by Tuesday EOD (2026-05-26). Sampling plan for longer-run controls by Tuesday as well.

Delivery mechanics: we prefer to stage evidence in a shared Drive folder (we will send a Drive link with access notes) and provide a zip export for procurement if needed. For sensitive logs we can provide redacted extracts and a short video walkthrough of the log extraction.

Attachments: redwood-caiq-mapping-template.csv (csv)

Irene Choi
Head of Trust Operations
Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com

Adding a few practical notes from the evidence side:

- Evidence owners (provisional):
  - Network controls / boundary enforcement: Rishi Malhotra (will supply firewall rules export + short pcaps where needed).
  - Key management / rotation: Security Engineering (I will coordinate with SE leads to produce rotation logs and KMS attestation PDF).
  - Runtime telemetry / request tracing: Marissa Cole (I will provide a 48hr log sample and a how-to extract document).

- Format decisions: where feasible we'll provide single-file artifacts (PDF or txt snippets) and avoid raw full log dumps. For items that require live verification (replay or tracing), we'll include a short screen recording (MP4) showing the extraction step. Expected artifacts are listed in the mapping template.

- A couple of controls you flagged (control IDs CAIQ-NET-07 and CAIQ-KMS-03) will need explicit sampling guidance. My proposal: 48-hour sampling window from Wed–Thu next week; deliver sample extracts + attestations. If that timing works, we'll calendar the window and share the access method.

I'll validate the mapping CSV this afternoon and tag owners in the Drive.

Attachments: runtime-log-sample-instructions.pdf (pdf)

Marissa Cole

Perfect — this is exactly the level of detail we need. A few quick confirmations:

- The proposed timeline works for procurement; please send the Drive link and mapping CSV when ready.
- For the 48-hour sampling window you proposed, Wed–Thu next week is fine. Tom from EdgeOps is looped on the cc to help with any log access coordination on our side.
